title: O3DE Pattern Definitions Schema 2.0.0
description: Common patterns used across O3DE schemas

$schema.description: The schema this O3DE object is using. i.e. 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/accesspointmg/canonical.o3de.org/main/src/o3de-manifest-2.0.0.json'

$schemaVersion.description: The version of the O3DE schema this O3DE object is using. i.e. '2.0.0'

objectName.description: Reverse-domain naming convention for O3DE objects (domain.organization.type.name). Must start with a reverse domain (e.g., 'com.company', 'org.organization'), followed by the object type, then a descriptive name using lowercase alphanumeric characters, underscores, and dots for hierarchy. Version numbers and pure numeric segments are not allowed in the name.

copyright_year.description: The year this object was created. i.e. 2023

copyright_text.description: The full copyright notice text. i.e. 'Copyright (c) 2024 APMG Corporation. All rights reserved.'

objectNameAndVersion.description: Combines objectName with semantic version constraints. Format: objectName followed by optional version constraint(s). Supports all semantic version operators: ==, >=, >, <=, <, ~=, !=. Multiple constraints can be comma-separated or comma-free. Examples: 'org.o3de.gem.core', 'com.apmg.gem.networking~=1.2.0', 'org.o3de.gem.physics>=1.2.0,<=1.3.0', 'org.o3de.gem.graphics>=1.0.0<2.0.0!=1.5.0', 'org.o3de.gem.network>=1.0.0,<3.0.0,!=1.2.0,!=2.5.0'

objectHeader.description: The header of this object which contains identification information.

version.description: The version of this object. i.e. '2.1.0'

display_name.description: The human readable name for this object displayed in the Project Manager. Note: This is not used by O3DE in any way other than to display a pretty, human readable name in the Project Manager.

id.description: id is a guid that uniquely identifies this object.

deprecated.description: Marks this object version as deprecated. Publishers use this to steer users away from problematic versions.

message.description: A human-readable message explaining why this version is deprecated. i.e. 'This version has a critical rendering bug. Please upgrade to 2.1.0.'

replacement.description: The name (and optionally version) of the object that replaces this one. i.e. 'org.o3de.gem.mygem>=2.1.0'

hooks.description: Optional scripts that run at key lifecycle points. Paths are relative to the object root.

post_install.description: Script to run after this object is downloaded and placed locally. i.e. 'scripts/setup.py' or 'scripts/post_install.cmd'. Use for code generation, asset processing, environment setup, etc.

pre_build.description: Script to run before a layout build begins. i.e. 'scripts/pre_build.py'. Use for environment validation, generated file updates, etc.

platform.description: Specify the platforms supported by this object. i.e. 'Windows', 'Linux', 'Mac', 'iOS', 'Android' or custom name

anyOf.description: Custom platform name: must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, and underscores

platform_map.description: A mapping string for O3DE platform name to CMAKE platform name in the format 'input:output' or 'input;output'

platforms_wart_map.description: A mapping string for platform names to platform warts in the format 'input:output' or 'input;output'. Platform warts are lowercase identifiers used in filenames.

canonical_tags.description: Canonical tags are used to sort, search and filter objects.

user_tag.description: Enumerated by the originator (creator/author), exclusive of the canonical_tags. These can be anything you want to tag your object with i.e. 'AI' or 'Space' or 'Human' etc.

user_tags.description: User tags are used to sort, search and filter objects.

origin.description: All thing related to objects originator (creator/author) goes here.

name.description: The name of the originator (creator/author) of this object. i.e. '<Company Name>' or 'John Doe'

email.description: The email of the originator (creator/author) of this object. i.e. 'support@mycomany.com' or 'bo@gus.com'

url.description: The url (website/ftp) for the originator (creator/author) of this object. i.e. 'https://www.mydomain.com'

engines.description: Relative path to a child engine.json. i.e. 'Engines/MyEngine/engine.json'

projects.description: Relative path to a child project.json. i.e. 'Projects/MyProject/project.json'

gems.description: Relative path to a child gem.json. i.e. 'Gems/MyGem/gem.json'

templates.description: Relative path to a child template.json. i.e. 'Templates/MyTemplate/template.json'

repos.description: Relative path to a child repo.json. i.e. 'Repos/MyRepo/repo.json'

overlays.description: Relative path to a child overlay.json. i.e. 'Overlays/MyOverlay/overlay.json'

relative_path.description: If your repo contains a icon to used by the Project Manager when the repo is local, then this is the relative path to the local icon file from this object's root. i.e. 'icons/preview.png'. If not supplied Project Manager will use the default icon when local.

url.description: The url to the icon file that is used by the Project Manager when the object is remote. i.e. 'https://www.mydomain.com/object/preview.png'. If not supplied Project Manager will use the default icon when remote.

relative_path.description: If your repo contains documentation, then this is the relative path to the documentation file from this object's root. i.e. 'docs/README.md'

url.description: If your documentation is online, then this is the url of the documentation. i.e. 'https://www.mydomain.com/MyObject/documentation/index.html'

download.description: A single download option with source and/or lfs archive URLs for source code. Format is detected from URL extension (.zip or .tar.gz).

source.description: The url of the source archive to download. i.e. 'https://github.com/o3de/o3de/archive/refs/tags/2409.2.zip'

lfs.description: The url of the lfs portion of the source archive to download. i.e. 'https://github.com/o3de/o3de/releases/download/2409.2/o3de-2409.2-lfs.zip'

relative_path.description: If this object is not in the root of the archive, then this holds relative path to this objects root. i.e. 'Gems/MyGem'

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the source archive for verifying the downloaded content has not been tampered with or corrupted.

lfs_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the lfs archive for verifying the downloaded content has not been tampered with or corrupted.

downloads.description: If this object is available as download(s). Each item represents a download option (e.g., different formats or mirrors). Each can have source and lfs URLs.

binary.description: A pre-built binary download option with platform and binary URL.

platform.description: The platform this binary is built for. i.e. 'Windows 11 AMD64', 'Ubuntu 24.04 AMD64', 'MacOS ARM64'

binary.description: The url of the compiled binary archive to download. i.e. 'https://github.com/o3de/o3de/releases/download/2409.2/o3de-windows11-AMD64-2409.2.tar.gz'

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the binary archive for verifying the downloaded content has not been tampered with or corrupted.

binaries.description: If this object is available as pre-built binaries. Each item represents a platform-specific binary.

source_control.description: If this object is available via source control, like git, that goes here.

git.description: The url of the source repo. i.e. 'https://github.com/o3de/o3de.git'

relative_path.description: If this object is not in the root of the source repo, then this holds relative path to this objects root. i.e. 'Gems/MyGem'

branch.description: If you want people to pull this object from a branch other than the default branch. i.e. 'development'

tag.description: If you want this object to be pulled at a specific tag instead of the head revision. i.e. 'v_1.2'

name.description: The release name can be anything, usually a date or fun name or hash. i.e. '24.04' or 'Cherry' or 'e01b344d'

local.description: A local is a full path to an o3de object's .json file on the local file system.

engines.description: Full path to a local engine.json. i.e. 'C:/Users/colinb/Engines/MyEngine/engine.json' or '/home/colinb/Engines/MyEngine/engine.json'

projects.description: Full path to a local project.json. i.e. 'C:/Users/colinb/Projects/MyProject/project.json' or '/home/colinb/Projects/MyProject/project.json'

gems.description: Full path to a local gem.json. i.e. 'C:/Users/colinb/Gems/MyGem/gem.json' or '/home/colinb/Gems/MyGem/gem.json'

templates.description: Full path to a local template.json. i.e. 'C:/Users/colinb/Templates/MyTemplate/template.json' or '/home/colinb/Templates/MyTemplate/template.json'

repos.description: Full path to a local repo.json. i.e. 'C:/Users/colinb/Repos/MyRepo/repo.json' or '/home/colinb/Repos/MyRepo/repo.json'

overlays.description: Full path to a local overlay.json. i.e. 'C:/Users/colinb/Overlays/MyOverlay/overlay.json' or '/home/colinb/Overlays/MyOverlay/overlay.json'

remote.description: A remote is URL to an o3de object json. Usually this is just a copy of the object's <object>.json file put somewhere that it can easily be retrieved. Usually it is copied to a web/ftp server or even a local/network drive. The o3de object json should contain all information needed by the Project Manager to show the user that the object can be downloaded and become an entry in the 'local' list in your o3de_manifest.json.

engines.description: URL or path to a remote engine.json. i.e. 'https://apmg.com/Engines/MyEngine/engine.json' or 'ftps://apmg.com/Engines/MyEngine/engine.json' or 'C:/apmg/Engines/MyEngine/engine.json' or '/apmg/Engines/MyEngine/engine.json'

projects.description: URL or path to a remote project.json. i.e. 'https://apmg.com/Projects/MyProject/project.json' or 'ftps://apmg.com/Projects/MyProject/project.json' or 'C:/apmg/Projects/MyProject/project.json' or '/apmg/Projects/MyProject/project.json'

gems.description: URL or path to a remote gem.json. i.e. 'https://apmg.com/Gems/MyGem/gem.json' or 'ftps://apmg.com/Gems/MyGem/gem.json' or 'C:/apmg/Gems/MyGem/gem.json' or '/apmg/Gems/MyGem/gem.json'

templates.description: URL or path to a remote template.json. i.e. 'https://apmg.com/Templates/MyTemplate/template.json' or 'ftps://apmg.com/Templates/MyTemplate/template.json' or 'C:/apmg/Templates/MyTemplate/template.json' or '/apmg/Templates/MyTemplate/template.json'

repos.description: URL or path to a remote repo.json. i.e. 'https://apmg.com/Repos/MyRepo/repo.json' or 'ftps://apmg.com/Repos/MyRepo/repo.json' or 'C:/apmg/Repos/MyRepo/repo.json' or '/apmg/Repos/MyRepo/repo.json'

overlays.description: URL or path to a remote overlay.json. i.e. 'https://apmg.com/Overlays/MyOverlay/overlay.json' or 'ftps://apmg.com/Overlays/MyOverlay/overlay.json' or 'C:/apmg/Overlays/MyOverlay/overlay.json' or '/apmg/Overlays/MyOverlay/overlay.json'

code.description: The Two letter country code. i.e. 'US' or 'AF'.

name.description: The name of the country. i.e. 'United States' or 'Afghanistan'.

official_name.description: The official name of the country. i.e. 'United States of America' or 'Islamic Republic of Afghanistan'.

license_identifier.description: The SPDX identifier for the license. i.e. 'Apache-2.0' or the custom license identifier.

display_name.description: The human readable name of the license. i.e. 'Apache 2.0'

relative_path.definition: It is best practice to include a copy of the license in the object, this is the relative path to the license file from this object's root. i.e. 'licenses/mylicense.txt'

comments.description: This field provides a place to record comments about the license which may be desirable to reproduce.

items.description: If this license is limited to a specific scope state that here. i.e. 'Applies only to non-commercial uses.'

files.description: Specific files referenced for this license may be enumerated here. This is often used when license information is not written into the file itself.

relative_path.description: The relative path of the file from the root.

items.description: This field provides a place to record acknowledgements that may be required to be communicated in some contexts. This is not meant to include the actual complete license text, and may or may not include copyright notices (see also copyrightText). Use this field to record other acknowledgements, such as particular clauses from license texts, which may be necessary or desirable to reproduce.

checksum.description: The checksum property provides a mechanism that can be used to verify that the contents of a file have not changed.

comments.description: This field provides a place to record comments about the file which may be desirable to reproduce.

copyright.description: The text of copyright declarations for the file. If the copyrightText field is not present, it implies an equivalent meaning to NOASSERTION.

notice.description: This field provides a place to record potential legal notices found in the file. This may or may not include copyright statements.
